slides.title: Bill mein service charge? Mana kar sakte ho.
Khaana mast tha.
slides.body: Bill aaya. Neeche chhoti si line: "Service charge 10%". Bunty ko laga ye toh dena hi padta hai.

slides.title: Bunty card nikaal raha tha.
slides.body: "Mana karunga toh waiter kya sochega? Sab dekhenge." Pinky ne haath rok liya.

slides.title: Pinky: "Ye charge optional hai."
slides.body: "Restaurant ise bill mein khud se nahi jod sakta. Hatwana tumhara haq hai."

slides.label: KAANOON KYA KEHTA HAI
slides.title: Service charge voluntary hai.
slides.body:
CCPA guidelines (4 July 2022):
restaurant ya hotel ise default add
ya force nahi kar sakte.
Delhi High Court ne 28 March 2025
ko ise uphold kiya.
slides.small:
Source: CCPA Guidelines, 4 July 2022; Delhi High Court, 28 March 2025.
Ye general jaankari hai, legal advice nahi.

slides.label: TOH KYA KARO?
slides.title: Bill mein dikhe toh:
slides.body:
1. Politely bolo: "Service charge hata dijiye."
2. Na maane? National Consumer Helpline 1915 pe complaint karo.

slides.label: CHHOTA SA TIP
slides.title: Bill neeche tak padho.
slides.body:
Service achhi lagi?
Tip do, apni marzi se, apni amount.
Bas bill mein zabardasti nahi.

slides.title: Agli baar Bunty ne khud bola:
slides.body: "Service charge hata dijiye." Hata diya. Aur waiter bhaiya ko tip, apni marzi se.

lines: Us dost ko bhejo jo bill bina padhe pay kar deta hai.
Rights jo aapko pata nahi. Follow @naya.nagrik
